ela_analysis.interpretation: Homogeneous compression characteristics across image (High-ELA Fraction: 0.00%). No localized recompression anomalies detected.
limitations: ELA is calibrated for JPEG compression and is most informative on images with natural compression cycles.
Multiple uniform re-saves across the entire image reduce ELA sensitivity.
High-frequency natural edges (textures, foliage) naturally produce moderate ELA signals without tampering.

artifacts.description: 2D wavelet high-frequency detail energy map isolating camera sensor noise and localized variance discontinuities.

noise_residual_analysis.interpretation: Uniform sensor noise distribution across the image plane (Ratio: 0.000, Global Std: 0.00). Consistent with a single physical camera sensor capture.
limitations: PRNU sensor noise assumes uncompressed or high-quality photographic sources; severe compression attenuates sensor noise.
Smooth, untextured regions (sky, flat surfaces) provide the cleanest PRNU signatures; dense textures add scene contamination.
Wavelet high-frequency components from different camera sensors typically have cross-correlation < 0.25, while identical sensors exceed 0.60.

statistical_analysis.interpretation: Statistical and spatial gradient profiles consistent with natural imagery (Edge density: 0.000).
limitations: Copy-move block matching uses quantized feature hashing; heavily rotated or scaled duplicates may evade detection.
Histogram quantization spikes flag potential multiple compression/editing passes, but can occur naturally in high-contrast graphics.
Edge and blur metrics are influenced by natural optical depth of field (bokeh).

flags: Camera EXIF metadata is completely absent/stripped
metadata_analysis.interpretation: Image headers contain no camera or exposure metadata. Typical of AI-generated content, messaging platform stripping, or deliberate scrubbing.
limitations: EXIF metadata is stored in plain text within image file headers and can be modified or forged.
Social media platforms (Twitter/X, WhatsApp, Instagram) routinely strip all EXIF metadata for privacy; absence of EXIF alone does not prove malicious manipulation.
Timezone discrepancies between camera internal clocks and computer systems can create apparent timestamp mismatches.

ai_generated_detection.interpretation: Low synthetic anomaly score (0.324). Spectral and feature distributions are consistent with natural photographic acquisition.
limitations: EfficientNet-B4 is trained on ImageNet-1k and deployed as an empirical feature & entropy analyzer for AI artifact signatures.
The 'ai_probability' / 'ai_pattern_score' is an empirical fusion of logit entropy, feature dispersion, and 2D FFT spectral irregularity.
Recent diffusion models (e.g. Midjourney v6, SDXL, FLUX) produce sophisticated textures that may yield false negatives on low-res inputs.
Heavily recompressed social media images may lose high-frequency spectral artifacts, affecting detection confidence.
